stack.paperExecution: Advisories and research fills only; no account state, order placement or live execution.

phaseAReference.referenceUse: Frequency reference only; no proxy return, PnL, OOS or promotion claim.
phaseAReference.historicalL2Limitation: The Phase-A evidence used OHLCV depth proxy and cannot prove historical executable depth. This draft does not import that proxy as execution evidence.

historicalDevelopment.rule: Use exactly the frozen eight symbols as a Development research universe when their historical contract bars and required funding observations exist.
requiredHistoricalEvidence: funding archive exists where the holding interval requires it
historicalDevelopment.missingInformation: Exclude the row; do not rewrite past eligibility with a current exchangeInfo snapshot.

prospectiveFinalOos.rule: At each decisionTime, primaryUniverse = the frozen eight-symbol list intersected with symbols causally verified eligible at or before decisionTime.
prospectiveFinalOos.missingInformation: Exclude that symbol for the decision point; never use a later snapshot to backfill an earlier decision.

dynamicEligibility.btcMissing: SIDEWAYS/NO_TRADE because BTC is required for the regime; do not substitute another benchmark.
dynamicEligibility.coverageClaim: This is an eight-symbol primary design; it makes no 20- or 30-symbol coverage claim.

breadth.bullCondition: count(eligible symbols with completed 4h close > SMA180) >= ceil(eligibleSymbols * 2/3)
breadth.bearCondition: count(eligible symbols with completed 4h close < SMA180) >= ceil(eligibleSymbols * 2/3)
breadth.sensitivityRule: 50% is report-only and can never replace the primary 2/3 result after outcomes are observed.

regime.bull: BTC SMA60 > BTC SMA180 AND BTC completed 4h close > BTC SMA180
regime.bear: BTC SMA60 < BTC SMA180 AND BTC completed 4h close < BTC SMA180

candidate.buy: completed 1h close > maximum HIGH of the prior 120 completed 1h bars
candidate.sell: completed 1h close < minimum LOW of the prior 120 completed 1h bars

causality.featureRule: Every feature must come from a completed bar or a PIT public-data record with source/exchange timestamp and receivedAt known no later than decisionTime.
causality.regimeSnapshotRule: Use the latest completed 4h regime/universe snapshot whose completedCloseTime <= decisionTime.
causality.futureData: Reject; never repair with a later snapshot or current metadata.

entry.decisionEvent: A completed 1h breakout close is observed and all required market data has been fetched.
entry.scanStartedAt: Timestamp before market-data fetches; never reused as decisionTime.
entry.decisionTime: Date/time immediately after required Binance bars, eligibility metadata, funding and executable-book data are complete.
entry.theoreticalDecisionTime: The completed 1h bar close boundary used only for scheduler-delay measurement.
entry.delayRule: schedulerDelayMs = decisionTime - theoreticalDecisionTime; if schedulerDelayMs > 900000, classify MISSED_SIGNAL and emit no Candidate eligible for trading or Advisory.

executableReference.buy: First valid causal ask-side executable price received at or after decisionTime, using the public Binance book available to the scanner.
executableReference.sell: First valid causal bid-side executable price received at or after decisionTime, using the public Binance book available to the scanner.
executableReference.entryPrice: The size-aware executable reference used by the existing Net Edge book walk; never a 1h/4h bar open.

historicalDevelopmentExecutionProxy.name: HISTORICAL_5M_EXECUTION_PROXY
historicalDevelopmentExecutionProxy.selection: After candidate/regime/features/side are frozen, require an archived Binance USD-M contract-price 5m bar whose openTime === requiredExecutionOpenTime.
historicalDevelopmentExecutionProxy.entryPrice: The selected 5m bar OPEN only for the post-decision Development execution simulation.
historicalDevelopmentExecutionProxy.missingRow: Exclude the row; no later-bar rescue and no selection of any later 5m bar.
historicalDevelopmentExecutionProxy.prospectiveOosReplacement: Use the real causal bid/ask/book executable reference and existing Net Edge book walk.

entry.historicalExecutionRule: The exact archived 5m observation with openTime === theoreticalDecisionTime + 5 minutes is read only after the signal decision is frozen; it can change the Development label/outcome, never candidate creation. If that exact row is missing, exclude the row; no better-price search or later-bar rescue is allowed.

exit.initialStop: BUY stop = executable entry - 2.0 * ATR20; SELL stop = executable entry + 2.0 * ATR20.
exit.dynamicChannel: At each completed 1h close, BUY exits when close <= the minimum LOW of the prior 60 completed 1h bars excluding the current bar; SELL exits when close >= the maximum HIGH of the prior 60 completed 1h bars excluding the current bar.

buy.gapThroughStop: If a post-entry 5m OPEN <= stopPrice, stop fill = that 5m OPEN.
buy.intrabarCross: Otherwise, if that 5m LOW <= stopPrice, stop fill = stopPrice.

sell.gapThroughStop: If a post-entry 5m OPEN >= stopPrice, stop fill = that 5m OPEN.
sell.intrabarCross: Otherwise, if that 5m HIGH >= stopPrice, stop fill = stopPrice.

stopMonitoring.stopPrecedence: If stop and channel are both triggered in the same evaluation period, stop wins.

channelMonitoring.buyRule: Exit when completed close <= minimum LOW of prior 60 completed 1h bars.
channelMonitoring.sellRule: Exit when completed close >= maximum HIGH of prior 60 completed 1h bars.

exit.terminalExit: If neither stop nor adverse channel exits first, exit at the close of the sixth completed 1h bar strictly after entryTime.
exit.sameBarPrecedence: If stop and adverse channel are both observable in the same evaluation period, stop fill is applied first as the conservative outcome.
exit.researchExpirySeparation: Research/advisory expiry controls record validity only; it never substitutes for or closes the trade exit.

edgeTarget.name: GROSS_DIRECTIONAL_PRICE_RETURN_BPS
edgeTarget.definition: For BUY: 10000 * (exitPrice / executableEntryPrice - 1). For SELL: 10000 * (1 - exitPrice / executableEntryPrice). Exit is the exact frozen stop/channel/terminal policy before any cost.
edgeTarget.expectedPriceEdgeBps: Prediction of the gross directional price-return target only.
edgeTarget.standardErrorBps: Predictive standard error for the same gross directional price-return target.
edgeTarget.expectedFundingBps: Separate causal funding estimate supplied independently to Net Edge; it is not included in expectedPriceEdgeBps.

expectedFundingBps.rule: If nextFundingTime is outside the possible six-hour hold, expectedFundingBps=0. If it falls inside the possible hold, use the latest published funding rate once, side-adjusted: BUY=-rate*10000 and SELL=rate*10000.
expectedFundingBps.additionalUnknownFunding: Represent only with frozen fundingStressBps; never read a future realized rate.

historicalDevelopmentFundingExpectationP.name: HISTORICAL_FUNDING_EXPECTATION_PROXY
historicalDevelopmentFundingExpectationP.latestFundingRow: Latest historical funding row with eventTime <= theoreticalDecisionTime; if none, the row is unusable.
historicalDevelopmentFundingExpectationP.withinWindowRule: If theoreticalDecisionTime < nextFundingTimeProxy <= theoreticalDecisionTime + 6 hours, use the latestFundingRow.fundingRate once, side-adjusted; otherwise expectedFundingBps=0 when the derived schedule is valid but outside the window.
historicalDevelopmentFundingExpectationP.invalidOrStaleSchedule: Fail closed and exclude the row.
historicalDevelopmentFundingExpectationP.prospectiveOosReplacement: Use the actual causally available live funding information at decisionTime.

realizedFundingBps.source: Actual funding events whose fundingTime falls in the realized holding interval

fundingCausality.leakageRule: expectedFundingBps and realizedFundingBps are separate fields; future realized funding cannot affect Candidate, Edge availability or the decision-time Net Edge result.

edgeModel.method: Ridge regression with intercept; (X'X + lambda * I)^-1 X'y; intercept is not penalized.
edgeModel.sensitivityUse: Report stability only; lambda=1 remains primary and cannot be selected after outcomes.

featureParity.historicalDevelopmentInputs: Completed causal bars and fixed-eight historical research-universe fields only.

featureTransform.missingFeature: Exclude row and do not impute.
featureTransform.winsorization: For each feature, fit lower/upper bounds at the training 1st/99th percentiles and clip validation/OOS values to those frozen bounds.
featureTransform.normalization: For each feature, fit training mean and population standard deviation after winsorization; z-score with frozen values; zero-variance feature becomes 0 for every split.
featureTransform.targetTransform: No target winsorization or normalization; target remains bps.
featureTransform.fitScope: Transforms are fit on the training portion of each walk-forward fold only.

uncertainty.formula: standardErrorBps(x) = sqrt(residualMSE * (1 + x' * (X'X + lambda*I)^-1 * x)) using the training residualMSE and frozen transformed x.
uncertainty.residualMSE: Training ridge residual SSE divided by max(1, n - p), where p is the number of transformed features plus intercept.
uncertainty.calibrationSource: Out-of-fold validation predictions only; never training predictions.

costs.engine: Existing HENGYU-NET-EDGE-001 implementation and config/net-edge-model.json; unchanged and reserved for Prospective Final OOS.

base.funding: Realized funding events known for the holding period; expectedFundingBps remains a separate model input.

stress.rule: Multiply fee, stressed book cost, impact, latency and funding-stress components by 1.5; leave gross price return and realized funding observations unchanged.

historicalDevelopmentNetEdgeProxy.name: HISTORICAL_DEVELOPMENT_NET_EDGE_PROXY
historicalDevelopmentNetEdgeProxy.finalOosReplacement: Prospective Final OOS uses real causal bid/ask/book and the unchanged HENGYU-NET-EDGE-001 implementation.

portfolioRisk.source: Existing config/net-edge-model.json risk policy; unchanged for this draft.
portfolioRisk.dedupeRule: At most one paper advisory per symbol/side/decisionTime/model cell; portfolio gate evaluates all open paper positions.
portfolioRisk.noOrderSizing: Sizing is research-only risk accounting and never an order instruction.

window.prior0019Window: 2025-07-01T00:00:00.000Z through 2026-07-01T00:00:00.000Z remains Development information and can never be independent OOS.
window.dataRule: Use only already-consumed or otherwise available historical information; no new data result is created by this draft.

dataSources.bars: Binance USD-M contract-price completed 1h, 4h and archived 5m public kline records; mark-price kline is not a signal source.
dataSources.funding: Historical Development uses HISTORICAL_FUNDING_EXPECTATION_PROXY from eventTime, fundingIntervalHours and fundingRate; Prospective Final OOS uses causally available live funding. Missing or invalid historical schedule makes the row unusable.
dataSources.eligibility: FIXED8_HISTORICAL_RESEARCH_UNIVERSE for Development; no historical PIT exchangeInfo claim and no current exchangeInfo backfill.
dataSources.entry: HISTORICAL_5M_EXECUTION_PROXY requires the exact +300000ms 5m open for Development; live causal bid/ask/book for Prospective Final OOS.
dataSources.depth: No historical full-L2 purchase or dependency; the 5m proxy is explicitly NOT_L2 and NOT_EXACT_FILL.
dataSources.backfill: No retrospective source or metadata backfill may create a missing causal bar, funding row or execution-proxy row.

executionProxy.selection: exactly one 5m bar with openTime === requiredExecutionOpenTime, selected only after Candidate/regime/features/side are frozen

fundingCausality.expectedFundingBps: HISTORICAL_FUNDING_EXPECTATION_PROXY for Development; decision-time latest published rate plus nextFundingTime rule for Prospective OOS; never a future realized rate.
fundingCausality.realizedFundingBps: Outcome-only actual funding events after the decision; never a Candidate or Net Edge input.
fundingCausality.historicalProxy: Use only the latest eventTime <= theoreticalDecisionTime plus its recorded fundingIntervalHours; never read the next future funding row's rate.

walkForward.purgeRule: For validation start V, a training row is eligible only if its six-bar labelEndTime <= V - 6 completed 1h bars.
walkForward.embargoRule: Rows with decisionTime in [validationEnd, validationEnd + 6 completed 1h bars) cannot enter the next training fit.
walkForward.oosIsolation: No final prospective OOS row is read, summarized, queried, exported, optimized or used in any fold.

measurementDefinitions.advisory: One deduplicated paper Advisory that passed candidate, validated Edge, Net Edge and Portfolio Risk; OBSERVE, NO_TRADE, MISSED_SIGNAL and rejected candidates do not count.
measurementDefinitions.monthlyAdvisoryRate: Advisory count divided by elapsed calendar days multiplied by 30; no rounding up and no zero-advisory month is removed.
measurementDefinitions.netExpectancyBps: Mean realized net return per admitted paper advisory after fees, spread/book cost, slippage, impact, latency and realized funding.
measurementDefinitions.netProfitFactor: Sum of positive realized net advisory returns divided by the absolute sum of negative realized net advisory returns; zero denominator fails.
measurementDefinitions.positiveMonthShare: Positive net MTM result months divided by all calendar months in the frozen evaluation window, including zero months.
measurementDefinitions.maxMTMDrawdown: Worst peak-to-trough mark-to-market NAV drawdown under the frozen research risk policy; closed-equity drawdown alone is insufficient.
measurementDefinitions.cvar95: Mean of the worst 5% daily mark-to-market NAV returns, expressed as a positive loss fraction.
measurementDefinitions.lossStreak: Maximum consecutive admitted advisories with negative realized net return.
measurementDefinitions.calibration: Out-of-fold predicted gross edge versus realized gross directional price return, computed pooled and separately per model cell before Net Edge and Portfolio Risk filtering.
measurementDefinitions.calibrationPopulation: All primary TREND_BREAKOUT candidates for which the frozen Edge model returns available=true, before Net Edge and Portfolio Risk filtering; rejected advisories are retained in the calibration population.
measurementDefinitions.zeroEdgeBaseline: Prediction of 0 gross bps on the same calibration rows, evaluated with the same MAE/RMSE definitions.
measurementDefinitions.coverageOnly: Regime, candidate, Edge-available candidate, distinct symbol and month counts only; no outcome, PnL, return, PF, DD, CVaR or realized calibration field.

development.rationale: 220 advisories is approximately 12 per 30 days across the 18-month window and is materially above the Phase-A H12 reference of 112 candidates, while remaining below the 1533-observation Trend Breakout opportunity funnel.

finalOos.rationale: The 90-day OOS gate keeps the same 12-per-30-day usable-frequency target while requiring positive net results after realistic base and stressed costs. Regime-side advisory gates are conditional on the separate frozen coverage gate.
finalOos.calibrationPopulationRule: All Edge-available primary TREND_BREAKOUT candidates before Net Edge and Portfolio Risk filtering; do not restrict to Gmail advisories.
finalOos.coverageConditionalSideGates: Apply BULL/BUY and BEAR/SELL advisory minimums only for cells meeting coverageMinimumPerCell; if a cell remains below coverage at day180, result is INCONCLUSIVE_REGIME_COVERAGE and cannot promote.

gates.failureAction: If any mandatory Development gate fails, set HY-EXP-0024 FAIL/FROZEN, make Final OOS unreadable, stop, and require a new experiment ID for any retry. No threshold, family, breadth, hold, lambda or cost rescue is allowed.

execution.labelSemantics: Use the exact primaryModel.exit stop, channel and terminal label semantics; Development and Prospective Paper OOS use the same frozen outcome definitions and never use different label rules.

startResolution.start: First UTC 00:00 boundary at or after the anchor; resolve once and then freeze.
startResolution.endExclusive: oosStart + 90 * 24 hours when day90 coverage is sufficient; otherwise oosStart + 180 * 24 hours under the frozen coverage-only extension rule.

coverageOnlyExtension.day90Inspection: Before any performance field is read, inspect only coverage fields.
coverageOnlyExtension.ifBothCellsMeetMinimum: Unlock final evaluation after the first 90-day period; do not extend.
coverageOnlyExtension.ifEitherCellBelowMinimum: Automatically extend exactly one additional 90-day period without reading PnL or performance; no optional stopping.
coverageOnlyExtension.day180Action: Evaluation is mandatory. If a cell remains below 40 Edge-available candidates, result=INCONCLUSIVE_REGIME_COVERAGE and no production promotion.

ONLINE_INFERENCE_INPUT.purpose: Frozen online inference only; not an OOS-result read.

SEALED_OUTCOME_EVALUATION.unlockedAfter: Full OOS period ends and coverage rule permits evaluation

dataWorkflow.afterDevelopmentPass: Only ONLINE_INFERENCE_INPUT reads and ONLINE_DECISION_OUTPUT writes are allowed during OOS; SEALED_OUTCOME_EVALUATION remains unreadable until its explicit unlock.
dataWorkflow.beforeOosStart: No final OOS record may enter a Development fit or metric.
dataWorkflow.duringOos: GitHub Actions -> Vercel -> Binance public data -> Candidate -> frozen Edge -> Net Edge -> Portfolio Risk -> Supabase; existing Gmail may deliver PAPER advisories.
dataWorkflow.afterOosEnd: Evaluate once after the full permitted 90- or 180-day period; no early promotion or OOS-based retraining.

prospectiveFinalOos.failure: HY-EXP-0024 FAIL/FROZEN; no rescue, no early promotion, no OOS retraining, and any changed semantics require a new experiment ID.

gmail.provider: Existing Gmail implementation and credentials; unchanged.
gmail.medium: Existing DIGEST_15M semantics if operationally supported

delivery.productionAuthorization: This draft does not authorize production changes; any successful OOS requires a separate promotion review.

reviewRequired.nextAllowedAction: Reviewer acceptance followed by a separate preregistration commit.
